Messages.Author: Pascal Bertrand
Messages.Body:
Hello everyone,
Lille is organizing this year's North ECQ for France.

The event will be held in the  Croisades Dunnord convention.

Please note this event is a nightly event. It starts at 21:00 (9PM) on Saturday, 31 March and will end in the early morning lights (~7AM on April the 1st).

The address of the event is :
13 Rue de Toul
59800 Lille
France

It's a 10-15 min walk from metro stations "Port de Lille", "Cormontagne", "République Beaux-Arts", and a 25 min walk from the international Gare de Lille-Flandres train station, and an extra 5 mins from the Lille-Europe train station.

Entrance fee will be 6 Euros. This covers promos, boosters, and the T-shirt if you're a happy qualified player.

The format is the same construct as usual. Banned cards are banned, no card-limit (apart from the 60-90/12 usual requirements)

We'll be very pleased to have players from Belgium, the UK, Netherlands or Germany attend the event

A qualifier for the French Nationals will be organized in the same place on April the 1st, an hour or two (let's leave some time to let players debrief their games:) ) after the finals.
